part.description: Garment part. Recommended keys: main, outer, lining, filling, trim, sole, upper, insole. 'main' when the product has one composition.

fiber.description: Fibre key, lowercase English (recommended list in docs/import-format.md#fibres), e.g. cotton, organic_cotton, elastane, wool, merino_wool, polyester, recycled_polyester, polyamide, viscose, linen, silk, leather.

fibers.description: Percentages of one part SHOULD sum to 100.
